title: 1992-93 Upper Deck #457 Alonzo Mourning Basketball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This sports trading card features Alonzo Mourning, a prominent baseball player, from the 1992-93 season. The card is part of the 1992-93 Upper Deck set and has a card number of 457. It is a great addition to any sports trading card collection and a must-have for fans of Alonzo Mourning. The card is produced by Upper Deck, a trusted manufacturer in the sports trading card industry.

This item is categorized under Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop and Sports Trading Cards, specifically under Trading Card Singles. Don't miss out on the opportunity to add this rare and valuable sports trading card to your collection.
